decisive_items: multiple hyperechoic regions with indistinct margins within the ventricular lumens
areas of high signal intensity on T1-weighted images and low signal intensity on T2-weighted images within the ventricles
response.rationale: Intraventricular hemorrhage pattern with echogenic intraventricular debris, irregular ventricular walls, and T1-hyperintense/T2-hypointense blood products supports fetal stroke; normal TORCH and coagulation workup make infection or a bleeding diathesis less likely.

rejected.why: No hepatic or systemic features of neonatal hemochromatosis; the T1/T2 signal pattern reflects intraventricular blood products, not liver iron deposition.
TORCH panel returned within normal limits and there are no systemic congenital infection features; ventriculomegaly alone is nonspecific.
